visual_grammar.medium_handling: Dense matte dark fields ruptured by incandescent transparent-to-opaque plumes, with glowing edges and particulate ejecta rising through the surface.
visual_grammar.composition: Strong upward thrust from a low source: cones, conduits, columns, fountains, or new ground pushing into open space.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Hard fresh-rock silhouettes near the source, soft turbulent plume edges above, and occasional glassy sharpness at newly cooled surfaces.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Abyssal dark ground against concentrated high-value heat; luminosity originates from below or within rather than from a neutral sky.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Cross-section or low monumental view that makes emergence from depth visible; enough vertical room for the process to rise.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Maximum detail at vent, conduit, fresh crust, and ejecta; the surrounding field simplifies as heat and plume disperse.
visual_grammar.finish: Incandescent, glassy, and newly made, with the freshest surfaces still visually radiating.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Flat mineral-color bands accumulated in distinct layers, with small variations in grain, thickness, and inclusion rather than blended painterly modeling.
visual_grammar.composition: Strictly horizontal cross-section or cut-face organization; the picture plane itself behaves like an exposed archive of successive beds.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Long continuous bedding contacts with subtle irregularity, fine lamination, and crisp readable boundaries between deposited intervals.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Even archival illumination and restrained contrast; differences between layers carry more information than dramatic highlights.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Orthographic or near-orthographic cut-face view, often with little conventional horizon; time is read vertically through stacked depth.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail is distributed by layer—fossils, grains, ash, color shifts, and unconformities appear as evidence inside otherwise calm bands.
visual_grammar.finish: Banded, measured, patient, and legible like a core log without becoming sterile technical drafting.
avoid: strong diagonal motion as the base composition

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Granular dots, dry particulate fields, translucent dust, and eroded edges that visibly release material into motion.
visual_grammar.composition: Wind- or water-swept diagonals, dunes, currents, and drifting streams; mass yields into transport rather than holding a fixed center.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Downstream/downwind edges dissolve into particles while up-current forms remain more legible; contours abrade instead of snapping.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Pale mineral mid-values, dust, bone, and sediment against softened shadows; contrast diffuses with distance and motion.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Medium-to-wide field view or process cross-section that leaves visible room for material to travel through the frame.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Fine grain clusters near source and settling zones, thinning into sparse moving particles across open ground.
visual_grammar.finish: Hazy, granular, mobile, and visibly worn, with forms surrendering their edges without losing process legibility.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Matte slate and charcoal blocks interrupted by one vivid mineral seam or fracture, with sharply offset strata and occasional granular debris.
visual_grammar.composition: Continuity visibly displaced across a diagonal or oblique slip plane; the same body appears on both sides but no longer at the same position.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Hard breaks, sheared contacts, scarps, and crisp displacement lines, contrasted with intact banding that proves what used to align.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Low-to-mid dark mineral masses with raking highlights and one high-chroma fracture/seam accent.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Cross-section, cut block, or raking landscape view chosen to make offset measurable at a glance.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Precision concentrates along the fault trace, displaced markers, scarps, and fresh fracture surfaces; intact blocks remain simpler.
visual_grammar.finish: Stillness immediately after violence: dry, displaced, exact, with strain legible in geometry rather than spectacle.
avoid: random cracked texture with no displacement logic
